messages:
Maya R: FYI preprod scanner found a backup tar with Vault sealed blobs in a partner bucket: s3://partner-backups/redwood/2026-03-22-sealed.tar.gz
Sam T: link + crc? any context on who uploaded and the IAM used?
Maya R: object metadata: uploader=partner-archive-sa@partner-prod, crc32c: a1b2c3d4. looks like a scheduled export from partner staging.
oncall-bot: ALERT: unusual blob upload detected for partner-archive-sa (rule: sealed-blob-detect)
Leah K: if those are Vaultiphertexts we need to ensure the wrapping key isn't usable by that SA. what KMS key?
Maya R: wrap key: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/onboard-kr/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrap-v1 (HSM).
Sam T: immediate steps: 1) remove decrypt binding for partner SA on that key 2) copy object to quarantine 3) snapshot KMS & Vault audit logs 4) start token accessor sweep. I'll coordinate.
Maya R: running commands now:
```
# save IAM
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy onboard-wrap-v1 --location=global --keyring=onboard-kr > /tmp/onboard-policy-before.json
# remove SA decrypt
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding onboard-wrap-v1 --location=global --keyring=onboard-kr --member="serviceAccount:partner-archive-sa@partner-prod" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
# quarantine
aws s3 cp s3://partner-backups/redwood/2026-03-22-sealed.tar.gz s3://sec-quarantine/partner-2026-03-22-sealed.tar.gz
```
Leah K: good. I'll enable Vault audit for the namespace and forward to splunk. also flip on KMS key usage export for 90 days.
Maya R: quarantine copy done, IAM snapshot saved to gs://ops/audit/onboard-policy-before.json. logs show partner-archive-sa was granted decrypt via onboarding script 3 days ago.
Sam T: we'll treat as likely accidental onboarding misconfig. plan: revoke SA decrypt now, run token sweep for accessors associated with the partner, create new key version and rewrap legit blobs only, and add CI gate to onboarding pipeline.
Leah K: to reduce risk during rewrap, create a canary job that rewraps a small set and validates restores. I can run validations.
Maya R: created incident record INC-2026-047. tagging Legal + PartnerOps. partner contact acknowledges accidental export; no sign of external access other than the object itself.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-047 (severity: medium) assigned to Sam T, Leah K
Sam T: token sweep in progress: using `vault token revoke -accessor` correlated to audit IPs. ETA 60m.
Leah K: created a PR to require manual review for granting cryptoKeyDecrypter in partner onboarding: https://github.com/redwood/onboarding/pull/492. request reviewers: infra-security.
Maya R: canary rewrap started (50 objects). validation checks: restore file, decrypt with new key version, integration test pass. so far 50/50 succeeded. debugging one failure (path mismatch).
Sam T: update: removed SA binding, token sweep removed 4 accessors, quarantine object preserved. next: rotate key (create new version) and run rewrap job after canary fixes.
Leah K: also adding monitoring alert: onboard pipeline should not grant decrypt role without codeowner approval.
Maya R: partner confirms no other uploads. scheduling postmortem 2026-03-23 10:00. will include remediation checklist: onboarding gate, CI tests, key-rotation runbook, and vault audit retention bump.
Sam T: thanks team. moving tracking to INC-2026-047. closing Slack thread for operational noise, will post updates in the incident ticket. :white_check_mark:
